concerns.text: Execution order states '(T107, T108 parallelizable in code, both before T109/T110)', but T108's sensitivity_summary.csv requires a non-null `permutation_p_value` per window-length row (per contracts/sensitivity_summary.schema.yaml, required field), and the permutation implementation only exists after T107. Running T108 in parallel with T107 leaves its required column unproducible. Either serialize T108 after T107 or remove the parallelizable claim.

T103 consumes `filter_subjects(manifest, behavioral)` but no task produces `data/raw/manifest.json` (listed as a canonical file in data-model.md). T102 fetches per-subject files only. A producer task for the manifest (or an explicit statement that T102 also writes it) is needed before T103 can run.
